_doc: Reserved backlog id blocks per (scope, project, session) so concurrent sessions never mint the same id (BI-PF-0462/0564). Owner/single writer: core/id_allocator.py. A shared PF API is the authority (POST /api/v1/backlog/ids:reserve); the allocator defaults to the reachable local API; offline a session allocates within its reserved block (PF_ID_BLOCK_BASE). Ids stay BI-<TAG>-<nnn>; blocks leave gaps.
